evidence_rules: The 1907 Egypt International, 1920 federation and 1945 registration provide deep pre-1955 institutional/competition context.
The 1976 current-name re-registration is gated to 1976 and does not create an artificial quality jump.
The 2024 national club-league structure is gated to 2024.
Historic tournament winners and modern player rankings are not calibration targets.
Strong tradition is separated from participation, access and elite-support dimensions.
